messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: 8%Warning: Error in if: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Jamie wrote to another user with a similar issue that "this error often happens when there are few occurrence records, high complexity features, and low regularization, which are all the ingredients to get a very complex model. If you get NA for AICc, that means there were more non-zero coefficients (model parameters) than you have occurrence records, which violates the assumptions of AIC. If you're using AIC for model selection, just ignore this model. You may also get NA for validation CBI because if there are not enough records in the training data during cross-validation, CBI will return NA -- this occurs with small datasets. I would just ignore it and use a different metric like omission rate or AUC."

But I haven't seen the TRUE/FALSE issue before, and I hadn't seen it crash Wallace either. Let's see if we can get him to chime in...
